text:
- **Owner questions on site:** Ask-tool questions now accept answers on the site as well as in chat. The first answer wins, and a hook event closes each question.
- **Stable AGENTS.md verdicts:** The check now gives the same verdict on every rerun. Known-good inputs always passed, and known-bad inputs always failed.
- **Agent and hook setup:** This repo turns off Claude Code's auto memory. Pm no longer installs a git hook or sets `core.hooksPath`; new worktrees get set up at session start.
- **Go test reliability:** `make test-go` now passes on every run. The service end-to-end test gets a free port from the kernel, not a shared one.
